==={{BotW|-}}===
Flowers appear in {{BotW}} both as [[Material]]s and [[Object]]s found throughout [[Hyrule|Hyrule Kingdom]]. The [[Armoranth]], [[Blue Nightshade]], [[Mighty Thistle]], [[Silent Princess]], and [[Swift Violet]], as well as the [[Cool Safflina|Cool]], [[Electric Safflina|Electric]], and [[Warm Safflina]]s are all usable in [[Cooking]] and in making [[Dye|Hateno Dyes]] at the [[Kochi Dye Shop]]. Additionally, the locations of [[Hearty Radish]]es and [[Big Hearty Radish]] are revealed by their distinct pink Flowers.

A Flower garden is featured prominently in the [[Shrine Quest]] "[[Watch Out for the Flowers]]".
